metadata.title: Arakelov inequalities and characterization of totally geodesic ball quotients in $\mathcal{A}_g$
metadata.abstract: We establish an Arakelov inequality for variations of Hodge structures underlying families of principally polarized complex Abelian varieties. In the equality case, this leads to a numerical characterization of certain totally geodesic ball quotients inside the moduli space of Abelian varieties. Our result extends work of Möller-Viehweg-Zuo by removing the strong positivity conditions imposed in their statement. For families over compact base spaces, our proof involves showing that the period map associated with a family of Abelian varieties factors through certain MMP operations and then generalizing the results of Möller, Viehweg, and Zuo to an appropriate singular setting. In the quasiprojective surface case, we implement a new approach that does not pass through Miyaoka-Yau-type uniformisation theorems but uses an argument going back to an idea of Mok, symmetric space theory and semistability considerations instead.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.progressType: Arakelov 等号与全测地球商
analysis.workSummary: 对主极化 Abelian 簇族的 Hodge 结构变分建立 Arakelov 不等式，以等号数值刻画模空间内某些全测地球商，并去除既有强正性假设。
analysis.breakthrough: 在紧底与拟射影曲面背景发展不同方法以弱化球商刻画条件。
analysis.limitations: 数值刻画针对所述族与等号情形；紧底和拟射影曲面两种论证范围不能混同。
analysis.priorityReason: 在紧底与拟射影曲面背景发展不同方法以弱化球商刻画条件。
